func zg(t *testing.T, r string, ok bool, a ...string) string {
	t.Helper()
	c := exec.Command("git", append([]string{"-C", r, "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@t", "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "-c", "init.defaultBranch=main"}, a...)...)
	out, err := c.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil && ok {
		t.Fatalf("git %v: %v %s", a, err, out)
	}
	return string(out)
}
func zw(t *testing.T, r, f, b string) {
	t.Helper()
	p := filepath.Join(r, f)
	os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755)
	if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(b), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func zr(t *testing.T) string { r := t.TempDir(); zg(t, r, true, "init", "-q"); return r }
func zc(t *testing.T, r string) {
	zg(t, r, true, "add", "-A")
	zg(t, r, true, "commit", "-q", "-m", "c")
}
func zcmp(t *testing.T, label, root string, a ...string) {
	args := append([]string{"-C", root}, a...)
	idx := filepath.Join(root, ".git", "index")
	before, _ := os.ReadFile(idx)
	got, err := RawGitDiffReadOnly(root, args...)
	after, _ := os.ReadFile(idx)
	want, werr := RawGit(args...).Output()
	t.Logf("%s: same=%v indexUnchanged=%v readonly=%q err=%v | plain=%q err=%v", label, string(got) == string(want), string(before) == string(after), got, err, want, werr)
}

func TestProbeRacyDefault(t *testing.T) {

	for i := 0; i < 6; i++ {
		r := zr(t)
		zw(t, r, "f", "aaaa\n")
		zc(t, r)
		time.Sleep(time.Until(time.Now().Truncate(time.Second).Add(1020 * time.Millisecond)))
		zw(t, r, "f", "bbbb\n")
		zg(t, r, true, "add", "f")
		zw(t, r, "f", "cccc\n")
		roots = append(roots, r)
	}
	time.Sleep(1500 * time.Millisecond)
	for _, r := range roots {
		zcmp(t, "racy", r, "diff", "--name-only")
	}
}

func TestProbeIndexStates(t *testing.T) {
	r := zr(t)
	zw(t, r, "a", "1\n")
	zc(t, r)
	zw(t, r, "a", "2\n")
	zc(t, r)
	idx := filepath.Join(r, ".git", "index")
	os.Rename(idx, idx+".real")
	os.Symlink("index.real", idx)
	zcmp(t, "symlinked", r, "diff", "--name-only", "HEAD~1")
	os.Remove(idx)
	zcmp(t, "missing", r, "diff", "--name-status", "HEAD")
	_, err := os.Lstat(idx)
	t.Logf("absent after: %v", os.IsNotExist(err))
	os.Mkdir(idx, 0o755)
	_, err = RawGitDiffReadOnly(r, "-C", r, "diff", "--name-only")
	t.Logf("directory index: %v", err)
	os.Remove(idx)
	f, _ := os.Create(idx)
	f.Truncate(diffIndexLimit + 1)
	f.Close()
	_, err = RawGitDiffReadOnly(r, "-C", r, "diff", "--name-only")
	t.Logf("oversized index: %v", err)
	os.Remove(idx)
	if err := syscall.Mkfifo(idx, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { _, err := RawGitDiffReadOnly(r, "-C", r, "diff", "--name-only"); done <- err }()
	select {
	case err := <-done:

	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Logf("fifo index: still blocked after 3s")
		w, _ := os.OpenFile(idx, os.O_WRONLY, 0)
		w.Close()
		t.Logf("fifo released: %v", <-done)
	}
}

func TestProbeConcurrentWriter(t *testing.T) {
	r := zr(t)
	for _, f := range []string{"a", "b", "c"} {
		zw(t, r, f, "1\n")
	}
	zc(t, r)
	stop := make(chan struct{})
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		for i := 0; ; i++ {
			select {
			case <-stop:
				return
			default:
			}
			os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(r, "b"), []byte{byte('0' + i%10), '\n'}, 0o644)
			exec.Command("git", "-C", r, "add", "b").Run()
		}
	}()
	zw(t, r, "a", "2\n")
	bad := 0
	for i := 0; i < 200; i++ {
		got, err := RawGitDiffReadOnly(r, "-C", r, "diff", "--name-only", "HEAD", "--", "a", "c")
		if err != nil || string(got) != "a\n" {
			bad++
		}
	}
	close(stop)
	wg.Wait()
	t.Logf("concurrent writer: unexpected=%d of 200", bad)
}
